name: Sail Research
description: Research cloud with recurring monthly credits and ephemeral inference handling.
overview: Sail Research is an academic research cloud whose model APIs receive $5 of free credits each month. Its data processing agreement requires ephemeral processing on the inference path and prohibits training or improvement on that content without written consent; stateful Sailboxes are governed separately.
free_access: Credits cover the shared inference catalog
No card required for the research tier
Ephemeral processing on the inference path
notes: Research accounts only; capacity is shared with teaching workloads.
